name: invoice-reconciliation
description: Supplier vs Teena-Rimon invoice reconciliation: shared parsing/matching core, Lambda API and React UI

scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix core && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix infra
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix core && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix infra
scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run deploy --prefix infra
scripts.deploy:diff: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run diff --prefix infra
